def transform(grid, debug=False):
    bg,cands=key_info(grid)
    if not cands: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, keycol, keypts, spine, arm_side, bbox, thick=cands[0]
    other=[]
    for col,pts in get_components(grid):
      if col==bg or col==keycol: continue
      cx=sum(c for r,c in pts)/len(pts)
      if cx!=spine: other.append((col,pts,'left' if cx<spine else 'right',cx))
    target_side='right' if arm_side=='left' else 'left'
    pairs=[]
    for i,a in enumerate(other):
      for b in other[i+1:]:
        if a[2]!=b[2] and shape_sig(a[1])==shape_sig(b[1]):
          chosen,partner=(a,b) if a[2]==target_side else (b,a)
          size=len(chosen[1]); dist=abs(chosen[3]-spine)+abs(partner[3]-spine)
          pairs.append((size,dist,chosen,partner))
    if debug: return bg,cands[0],[(z[0],round(z[1],2),z[2][0],(min(r for r,c in z[2][1]),min(c for r,c in z[2][1])),z[3][0],(min(r for r,c in z[3][1]),min(c for r,c in z[3][1]))) for z in pairs]
    if pairs:
      pair=sorted(pairs,key=lambda z:(-z[0],z[1]))[0]; out=[row[:] for row in grid]
      for r,c in pair[2][1]: out[r][c]=keycol
      return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
